# NLP-stage ablation (generated by `python -m app.eval.nlp_ablation`; do not edit by hand)

System: B3 8-axis ⊕ CE with the hybrid JD parser (deterministic, zero LLM judgement). Each variant switches one CV-side NLP stage off by rewriting the parsed profile; retrieval, index and JD are identical. Labels and splits: NLP501-bench v1 (data/eval/benchmark_v1.json). Mean nDCG@10 over JDs, 95% bootstrap CI, paired one-sided bootstrap p. PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
